name: io.github.ObsidianCorps/umami-mcp
title: ObsidianCorps Umami Analytics
description: Umami v3 MCP for Cloud or self-hosted analytics, with read-only, privacy-conscious defaults.

environmentVariables.name: UMAMI_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Umami Cloud API key. Configure this or one self-hosted authentication mode.

environmentVariables.name: UMAMI_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Base URL of a self-hosted Umami instance, for example https://analytics.example.com.

environmentVariables.name: UMAMI_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Pre-issued self-hosted Umami token. Use with UMAMI_BASE_URL instead of login credentials.

environmentVariables.name: UMAMI_USERNAME
environmentVariables.description: Self-hosted Umami username. Use with UMAMI_BASE_URL and UMAMI_PASSWORD.

environmentVariables.name: UMAMI_PASSWORD
environmentVariables.description: Self-hosted Umami password. Use with UMAMI_BASE_URL and UMAMI_USERNAME.

environmentVariables.name: UMAMI_TWO_FACTOR_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: Optional Base32 TOTP setup secret for automatic Umami 3.3+ two-factor login.

environmentVariables.name: UMAMI_DEFAULT_WEBSITE_ID
environmentVariables.description: Optional default website UUID used when a tool call does not select a website.
